join_rule: inner join on UTC calendar date of event_time_utc vs trade entry date / daily row date; SCHED_MACRO = {FOMC_DECISION, ECB_DECISION, US_CPI_RELEASE, EZ_HICP_RELEASE, US_NFP}; SURPRISE = {ENERGY_INFRASTRUCTURE, GEOPOLITICAL}; OTHER_EVENT excluded from both (1-2 days per fold)
limitations: F4 window has no timeline coverage (events lane covered F1/F2/F5 detail + F3/F6 coarse per dispatch); F4 row is ALL=NO-EVENT by construction
same-day multi-event days counted once per category union
overlay is arithmetic on lane outputs; the skeptic lane re-derives independently
